title: wsl-agent-sandbox Configuration (Hardened Ubuntu 26.04 LTS WSL2 Sandbox)

installDir.description: Windows directory where the WSL ext4.vhdx will live. Supports %ENVVAR% expansion.

uid.description: Dedicated high UID so per-UID nftables rules do not collide with UID 1000 in other WSL distros.

url.description: Optional explicit download URL for the .wsl or .tar.gz rootfs.

sha256.description: Optional explicit SHA256 checksum (otherwise fetched from Canonical SHA256SUMS).

sharedFolders.description: Explicit allowlist of Windows directories mounted under /shared/<name> inside WSL.

network.description: Per-UID nftables and mirrored-loopback isolation policy for the agent user.

blockHostAndLan.description: When true, blocks direct agent egress to Windows host ports (including mirrored localhost/loopback0 port-forwards) and blockedCidrs.

allowedHostPorts.description: Explicit Windows host ports (e.g., kubectl port-forward, SSH tunnels, local Ollama) reachable by the agent user. Works directly on localhost in mirrored mode; in NAT mode bind the Windows listener to the vEthernet (WSL) IP or 0.0.0.0.

blockedCidrs.description: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges dropped for outbound agent traffic when blockHostAndLan is true.

logDrops.description: When true, rate-limit log blocked outbound agent connections to dmesg/journald before dropping.

egressMode.description: Public internet egress mode for the agent user: 'open' (default) or 'allowlist' (requires HTTP/HTTPS traffic through root-owned egress proxy).

allowedDomains.description: Allowlisted domains (e.g., 'api.github.com', '*.anthropic.com') or presets ('llm-apis', 'github', 'npm', 'pypi', 'apt') when egressMode is 'allowlist'.

enabled.description: Enable mediated Docker Desktop access via docker-policy-proxy. Note: Docker Desktop bridge containers can still reach Windows host/port-forwarded services via host.docker.internal unless disabled here or blocked by Windows Firewall.

allowPortBindings.description: Allow containers to publish ports to the Windows host via HostConfig.PortBindings.

forceLoopbackPortBindings.description: When PortBindings are allowed, force HostIp to 127.0.0.1 and reject 0.0.0.0 or LAN bindings.

allowedPublishedPorts.description: Optional allowlist of host ports containers are permitted to publish (empty = any valid port).

forceInternalNetwork.description: Restrict containers from using Docker Desktop's default bridge network (prevents container egress to host.docker.internal/Windows host/LAN).

defaultLimits.description: Default resource caps injected into HostConfig if unset.

maxLimits.description: Maximum allowed resource caps on container create/update.

allowedRegistries.description: Optional allowlist of container image registries (e.g., docker.io, ghcr.io, mcr.microsoft.com). Empty allows all.

configureVsCodeRemoteWsl.description: Optional alias for ide.configureRemoteWsl: when true, init and apply configure 'remote.WSL.experimental.scriptLessStartup': true in VS Code / Antigravity user settings.

ide.description: Optional Windows IDE (VS Code / Antigravity) Remote-WSL integration settings.

configureRemoteWsl.description: When true, '.\box.ps1 init' and '.\box.ps1 apply' automatically set 'remote.WSL.experimental.scriptLessStartup': true in VS Code and Antigravity user settings.json so Remote-WSL connects without /mnt/c or Windows interop.

secrets.description: Optional non-secret Windows path pointer for central CLI credential seeding via '.\box.ps1 seed-secrets'. Never store secret values in box.json.

manifestPath.description: Path to the central Windows secrets manifest JSON file (supports %ENVVAR% expansion). Defaults to %USERPROFILE%\.wsl-agent-sandbox\secrets.json.

resources.description: Optional per-UID systemd slice resource quotas for the non-root agent user (does not restrict root control-plane commands).

tasksMax.description: systemd TasksMax fork-bomb cap for user-<uid>.slice (e.g., 512).
